items.title: Why Is Allegion (ALLE) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
items.summary: Shares of security hardware provider Allegion (NYSE:ALLE) jumped 12.7% in the afternoon session after the company reported strong second-quarter financial results, beating analysts' revenue and earnings expectations while raising its full-year outlook. Revenue reached $1.15 billion, a 12.7% increase from the previous year, surpassing market expectations of $1.12 billion.
